vision: Pillai College of Engineering (PCE) will admit, educate and train in technology, a diverse population of students who are academically prepared to benefit from the Institute's infrastructure and faculty experience, to become responsible professionals.
mission: To develop professional engineers with respect for the environment and make them responsible citizens, both from a local and global perspective. This objective is fulfilled through quality education, practical training, research, entrepreneurship and interaction with industries and social organisations.

metrics.title: Curricular planning and implementation
metrics.description: The institution ensures effective curriculum delivery through a well planned and documented process. Explain the academic planning, adherence to academic calendar, lesson plans, course files, and teaching methods (e.g. Project-Based Learning, e-learning platforms) used to ensure delivery.
metrics.query_hints: effective curriculum delivery, academic planning calendar, lesson plans course file, academic monitoring system, syllabus coverage delivery process

metrics.title: Institution integrates cross-cutting issues into the curriculum
metrics.description: Institution integrates cross-cutting issues relevant to Professional Ethics, Gender, Human Values, Environment and Sustainability into the Curriculum. Describe courses, workshops, active clubs (like Nature Club), and programs addressing ethics, environment, and gender equity.
metrics.query_hints: integrates cross-cutting issues, gender sensitivity equality, environmental sustainability courses, human values professional ethics, nature club activities

metrics.title: Student diversity (Slow vs. Advanced Learners)
metrics.description: The institution assesses the learning levels of the students, after admission and organises special programs for advanced learners and slow learners. Explain the identification process, mentoring schemes, remedial classes, coaching for competitive exams (GATE, GRE), and research support.
metrics.query_hints: slow learners advanced learners, learning levels assessment, mentoring counseling scheme, remedial classes extra coaching, academic performance support

metrics.title: Student-centric methods
metrics.description: Student centric methods, such as experiential learning, participative learning and problem solving methodologies are used for enhancing learning experiences. Elaborate on project-based learning, maker spaces (Maker Studio), industrial visits, virtual labs, and student chapters.
metrics.query_hints: student centric methods, experiential learning projects, participative learning workshops, maker studio fabrication, virtual labs simulations

metrics.title: Ratio of students to mentor
metrics.description: Ratio of students to mentor for academic and stress related issues. Describe the mentor-mentee mechanism, frequency of meetings, training of mentors, and student counseling systems.
metrics.query_hints: mentor mentee ratio, student counseling mechanism, academic stress support, frequency of mentor meetings, counseling cell

metrics.title: Mechanism of internal assessment is transparent and robust
metrics.description: Mechanism of internal assessment is transparent and robust in terms of frequency and variety. Detail the continuous internal evaluation (CIE), term work assessments, project reviews, test schedules, and student access to evaluated papers.
metrics.query_hints: internal assessment mechanism, continuous internal evaluation CIE, transparency assessment grading, project evaluations tests rubrics

metrics.title: Mechanism to deal with internal examination related grievances
metrics.description: Mechanism to deal with internal examination related grievances is transparent, time-bound and efficient. Explain how exam-related complaints (marks updating, revaluation, grade card corrections) are handled by the college exam cell.
metrics.query_hints: examination grievances mechanism, exam cell complaints, revaluation paper verification, marks correction time bound

metrics.title: Programme and course outcomes are stated and displayed
metrics.description: Programme outcomes, program specific outcomes and course outcomes for all programs offered by the Institution are stated and displayed on website and communicated to teachers and students. Describe how COs, POs, and PSOs are defined, published, and communicated.
metrics.query_hints: course outcomes COs program outcomes POs, define outcomes communication, notice boards website dissemination, academic outcomes syllabus

metrics.title: Attainment of programme outcomes and course outcomes
metrics.description: Attainment of program outcomes, program specific outcomes and course outcomes are evaluated by the institution. Detail the direct and indirect assessment methods, Course Assessment Reports (CAR), weights, and actions taken for low attainment.
metrics.query_hints: attainment of outcomes evaluation, direct indirect assessment, course assessment reports CAR, feedback survey weightage

metrics.title: Innovation ecosystem including Incubation center
metrics.description: Institution has created an ecosystem for innovations including incubation centre and other initiatives for creation and transfer of knowledge. Describe centers of excellence (UXO, Drone Lab, Future Cities), start-up support, and research facilities.
metrics.query_hints: innovation ecosystem, incubation center startups, research centers of excellence, drone lab future cities, knowledge transfer IPR

metrics.title: Extension activities in neighborhood community
metrics.description: Extension activities in the neighbourhood community in terms of impact and sensitising students to social issues and holistic development during the last five years. Detail community programs like Community Service Day, Uber Rang, Swachh Bharat Internships, and social awareness campaigns.
metrics.query_hints: extension activities community, community service day, social issues awareness sensitisation, uber rang cultural night, swachh bharat internship

metrics.title: Adequate infrastructure for teaching-learning
metrics.description: The institution has adequate facilities for teaching- learning. viz., classrooms, laboratories, computing equipment, smart rooms, and specialized workshops.
metrics.query_hints: facilities classrooms laboratories, computing equipment smart class, infrastructure teaching learning, laboratories tools hardware

metrics.title: Facilities for sports, games, and cultural activities
metrics.description: The institution has adequate facilities for sports, games (indoor, outdoor), gymnasium, yoga centre etc., and cultural activities. Detail the playgrounds, sports complex, gym facilities, and cultural festivals (e.g. Alegria).
metrics.query_hints: sports facilities grounds, gymnasium yoga center, indoor outdoor games, cultural activities festival alegria

metrics.title: Library is automated using ILMS
metrics.description: Library is automated using Integrated Library Management System (ILMS). Describe the library software (e.g., Koha), database access, and e-resources subscriptions (ejournals, ebooks).
metrics.query_hints: library automated ILMS, koha software system, e-resources journals subscription, cataloging book issue circulation

metrics.title: IT infrastructure including Wi-Fi
metrics.description: Institution frequently updates its IT facilities including Wi-Fi. Detail the server rooms, internet bandwidth, firewalls, routers, computer labs, and upgrades.
metrics.query_hints: IT infrastructure updates, internet wifi bandwidth, server firewalls, computers ratio hardware specifications

metrics.title: Capacity building and skills enhancement initiatives
metrics.description: Capacity building and skills enhancement initiatives taken by the institution include soft skills, language and communication skills, life skills, and awareness of trends in technology. Detail training programs, workshops, attendance, and employability initiatives conducted.
metrics.query_hints: capacity building skills enhancement, soft skills training program, communication skills development, aptitude placement preparation, student participation

metrics.title: Placement of outgoing students and career counseling
metrics.description: The institution facilitates student placement and career counseling. Detail placement activities, industry drives, technical interviews, and follow-up activities organized by the Training and Placement Cell.
metrics.query_hints: placement activities conducted, training and placement cell, campus placement drives, career counseling, technical interview preparation

metrics.title: Presence of an active Student Council
metrics.description: Presence of an active Student Council & representation of students on academic & administrative bodies/committees of the institution. Outline the constitution of the student council, their roles, committees, and organizing student-led initiatives.
metrics.query_hints: student council representation, student committees representation, academic administrative bodies, student activities organization

metrics.title: Registered Alumni Association
metrics.description: There is a registered Alumni Association that contributes significantly to the development of the institution through financial and/or other support services. Detail alumni placement support, lectures, workshops, networking portals, and meetings.
metrics.query_hints: alumni association registered, alumni contribution support, placement mentorship lectures, alumni meet portal

metrics.title: Governance in tune with vision and mission
metrics.description: The governance of the institution is reflective of an effective leadership in tune with the vision and mission of the institution. Outline the management systems, participatory governance structures, perspective plans, and quality policies.
metrics.query_hints: governance leadership structure, vision mission alignment, perspective plan goals, board of governors BoG

metrics.title: Decentralization and participative management
metrics.description: The institution practices decentralization and participative management. Detail the college development committee, department budgets, academic committees, and administrative decentralization case studies (like lab modernization).
metrics.query_hints: decentralization participative management, college development committee, department budget allocation, academic committees autonomy

metrics.title: Strategic plan and deployment documents are effective
metrics.description: Perspective/Strategic plan and Deployment documents are available in the institution. Describe key strategic goals deployed, such as establishing research centers, MOUs with industries, and quality accreditations.
metrics.query_hints: strategic plan deployment, perspective plan objectives, industry MoUs agreements, research centers establishment

metrics.title: Institutional bodies as per statutory requirements
metrics.description: Organizational structure of the institution including governing body, administrative setup, and functions of various bodies, service rules, procedures, recruitment, and promotional policies.
metrics.query_hints: organizational structure setup, governing body administrative, service rules recruitment promotion, grievance redressal hierarchy

metrics.title: Effective welfare measures
metrics.description: The institution has effective welfare measures for teaching and non-teaching staff. Detail training support, sponsorships, leaves (sick, earned, casual), EPF schemes, health programs, and credit societies.
metrics.query_hints: welfare measures teaching staff, non teaching welfare, sponsorship fee reimbursement, health leaves EPF credit society

metrics.title: Institution conducts financial audits
metrics.description: Institution conducts internal and external financial audits regularly. Detail internal and external audit mechanisms, auditing agencies (e.g. CA firms), and budgeting controls.
metrics.query_hints: financial audits internal external, auditing process regular, accounts ledger budget control

metrics.title: IQAC initiatives
metrics.description: Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) has contributed significantly for institutionalizing the quality assurance strategies and processes. Describe quality initiatives like project-based learning, component library setup, and faculty training.
metrics.query_hints: IQAC quality initiatives, internal quality assurance cell, institutionalizing best practices, component library project based learning

metrics.title: Institutional reviews and implementation of teaching-learning
metrics.description: The institution reviews its teaching learning process, structures & methodologies of operations and learning outcomes at periodic intervals through IQAC set up as per norms. Detail academic audits and online monitoring systems (AMS).
metrics.query_hints: teaching learning review, academic audit committee, academic monitoring system AMS, student feedback course exit survey

criteria.title: Criterion 7 - Institutional Values and Best Practices

metrics.title: Promotion of gender equity
metrics.description: Measures initiated for the promotion of gender equity. Detail safety and security (CCTV, guards), counseling, common rooms, and gender equity promotion programs (Women Development Cell / ICC).
metrics.query_hints: gender equity promotion, women safety security CCTV, common room counseling cell, gender sensitivity programs

metrics.title: Institutional efforts in providing an inclusive environment
metrics.description: Institutional efforts in providing an inclusive environment (tolerance, harmony towards cultural, regional, linguistic, communal socio-economic and other diversities). Explain cultural programs, regional festivals, and social service campaigns.
metrics.query_hints: inclusive environment tolerance, harmony cultural regional, linguistic communal diversity, festivals celebrations

metrics.title: Sensitization to constitutional obligations
metrics.description: Sensitization of students to constitutional obligations: values, rights, duties and responsibilities of citizens. Describe programs celebrating Independence Day, Republic Day, Constitution Day, and related workshops.
metrics.query_hints: constitutional obligations citizenship, independence day republic day, values rights duties, constitution day sensitization

metrics.title: Institution celebrates commemorative days
metrics.description: Institution celebrates national/international commemorative days, festivals and birth/death anniversaries of great Indian personalities (like Gandhi, Shivaji, Ambedkar, Radhakrishnan).

metrics.title: Institutional Distinctiveness
metrics.description: Performance of the Institution in one area distinctive to its thrust. Elaborate on the core distinctiveness (e.g., student-centered research, project-based learning, or incubation/entrepreneurship cell).
